procedures.name: web_learned_install_from_play_store
riskPoints: Source: Google Play Help says to open Google Play, search or browse, select an item, then select Install or price.
Installing apps changes device state and requires confirm_user before tapping Install.
Paid apps, subscriptions, payment, login, permission, and account prompts require a separate confirm_user.

steps.intent: Open Google Play Store and reach the Search tab.
steps.expectedObservation: The Play Store search field or search tab is visible.
steps.fallbackStrategy: If the search field is not visible on launch, tap the bottom Search tab labelled 검색 or Search.

steps.intent: Type the requested app name in the Play Store search field and submit.
steps.expectedObservation: Search results for the requested app are visible.
steps.fallbackStrategy: Use the editable field with placeholder 앱 및 게임 검색 or Search apps & games.

steps.intent: Choose the requested app result and stop before installing.
steps.expectedObservation: The target app detail/result card and an Install button are visible.
steps.fallbackStrategy: If the result opens directly, look for 설치 or Install on the detail page.
